final: WITH account_counts AS (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM "order" GROUP BY account_id), first_average AS (SELECT AVG(order_count) AS avg_count FROM account_counts), kept AS (SELECT ac.account_id, ac.order_count, ac.order_count - fa.avg_count AS diff_first FROM account_counts ac CROSS JOIN first_average fa WHERE ac.order_count > fa.avg_count), second_average AS (SELECT AVG(order_count) AS avg_count FROM kept) SELECT k.account_id, k.order_count, k.diff_first, k.order_count - sa.avg_count AS diff_second FROM kept k CROSS JOIN second_average sa ORDER BY diff_second DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
